reason: A is the better proposal because it attributes mismatch to local compositional/microstructural heterogeneity rather than to elemental regions and uses a clearer homogenized-versus-standard comparison with direct residual-stress measurements. Both remain weakened by confounding microstructural changes during homogenization and by the likelihood that processing residual stresses relax during testing at 1250 °C, but B additionally reverses causality by suggesting thermal-mismatch stresses generate microsegregation.
